I love the LORD, for He has heard my voice— my appeal for mercy.
I have given my love to the Lord, because he has given ear to the voice of my cry and my prayer.
我愛耶和華，因為他聽了我的聲音和我的懇求。
Because He has inclined His ear to me, I will call on Him as long as I live.
He has let my request come before him, and I will make my prayer to him all my days.
他既向我側耳，我一生要求告他。
The ropes of death entangled me; the anguish of Sheol overcame me; I was confronted by trouble and sorrow.
The nets of death were round me, and the pains of the underworld had me in their grip; I was full of trouble and sorrow.
死亡的繩索纏繞我；陰間的痛苦抓住我；我遭遇患難愁苦。
Then I called on the name of the LORD: “O LORD, deliver my soul!”
Then I made my prayer to the Lord, saying, O Lord, take my soul out of trouble.
那時，我便求告耶和華的名，說：耶和華啊，求你救我的靈魂！
The LORD is gracious and righteous; our God is full of compassion.
The Lord is full of grace and righteousness; truly, he is a God of mercy.
耶和華有恩惠，有公義；我們的神以憐憫為懷。
The LORD preserves the simplehearted; I was helpless, and He saved me.
The Lord keeps the simple; I was made low, and he was my saviour.
耶和華保護愚人；我落到卑微的地步，他救了我。
Return to your rest, O my soul, for the LORD has been good to you.
Come back to your rest, O my soul; for the Lord has given you your reward.
我的心哪！你要仍歸安樂，因為耶和華用厚恩待你。
For You have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
You have taken my soul from the power of death, keeping my eyes from weeping, and my feet from falling.
主啊，你救我的命免了死亡，救我的眼免了流淚，救我的腳免了跌倒。
I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
I will go before the Lord in the land of the living.
我要在耶和華面前行活人之路。
I believed, therefore I said, “I am greatly afflicted.”
I still had faith, though I said, I am in great trouble;
我因信，所以如此說話；我受了極大的困苦。
In my alarm I said, “All men are liars!”
Though I said in my fear, All men are false.
我曾急促地說：人都是說謊的！
How can I repay the LORD for all His goodness to me?
What may I give to the Lord for all the good things which he has done for me?
我拿甚麼報答耶和華向我所賜的一切厚恩？
I will lift the cup of salvation and call on the name of the LORD.
I will take the cup of salvation, and give praise to the name of the Lord.
我要舉起救恩的杯，稱揚耶和華的名。
I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people.
I will make the offering of my oath to the Lord, even before all his people.
我要在他眾民面前向耶和華還我的願。
Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of His saints.
Dear in the eyes of the Lord is the death of his saints.
在耶和華眼中，看聖民之死極為寶貴。
Truly, O LORD, I am Your servant; I am Your servant, the son of Your maidservant; You have broken my bonds.
O Lord, truly I am your servant; I am your servant, the son of her who is your servant; by you have my cords been broken.
耶和華啊，我真是你的僕人；我是你的僕人，是你婢女的兒子。你已經解開我的綁索。
I will offer to You a sacrifice of thanksgiving and call on the name of the LORD.
I will give an offering of praise to you, and make my prayer in the name of the Lord.
我要以感謝為祭獻給你，又要求告耶和華的名。
I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people,
I will make the offerings of my oath, even before all his people;
我要在他眾民面前，在耶和華殿的院內，在耶路撒冷當中，向耶和華還我的願。你們要讚美耶和華！
in the courts of the LORD’s house, in your midst, O Jerusalem. Hallelujah!
In the Lord's house, even in Jerusalem. Praise be to the Lord.
